description:
Make package/toolchain classification in the Python docs generator a pure function, mirroring the already-pure parse_toolchain_data.

Source: architecture review (2026-07-17), candidate 3. Candidates 1 & 2 (buildPackage / buildPrebuiltBinary) already landed in the Nix registry; this epic is the remaining live piece, on the docs side.

Today scan_packages(packages_dir) interleaves filesystem I/O (iterdir + read_text + json.loads) with classification (name.endswith('-toolchain'), _meta extraction, version sorting, model construction), so the interpretation can only be tested through a real on-disk tree. parse_toolchain_data(dict) is already pure. This epic extracts a pure classify_entry seam and then reconciles the Nix/skill-bundle classification drift behind it.
title: Deepen docs scanner: pure package classification
